# Elite Bot Studios

> Embedded Intelligence. Real-World Power.

Elite Bot Studios is an independent engineering initiative and portfolio by Muhammad Shahzaib Abbas, an Electrical Engineering undergraduate at the National University of Sciences and Technology (NUST), Pakistan. His academic direction emphasizes power engineering, with complementary interests in embedded systems, electronics, microcontrollers, control, and intelligent energy systems.

The site is an evolving professional identity and technical notebook, not an established corporation or a claim of professional licensure. Concepts, learning topics, simulation, prototypes, and measured work are kept distinct. At present, the public project list contains a concept entry; no completed hardware case study or bench result is being claimed.

## Pages

- [Home](https://elitebotstudios.me/): engineering identity, focus areas, conceptual interactive power-system diagram, portfolio preview, and founder profile.
- [Projects](https://elitebotstudios.me/projects.html): evidence-labelled project records, currently including a concept only.
- [Expertise](https://elitebotstudios.me/expertise.html): academic focus, developing areas, and research interests; no proficiency percentages.
- [Engineering Lab](https://elitebotstudios.me/lab.html): Markdown-authored educational notes on documentation and simulation versus measurement.
- [Capabilities & collaboration](https://elitebotstudios.me/services.html): areas of study and possible collaboration, scoped responsibly.
- [Engineering tools](https://elitebotstudios.me/tools.html): six client-side calculators for PCB trace width, buck conversion, regulator thermal estimates, voltage dividers, LED resistors, and RC time constants.
- [About](https://elitebotstudios.me/about.html): founder background and research interests.
- [Contact](https://elitebotstudios.me/contact.html): a browser form that prepares an email draft; the visitor must send it from their own email application.

## Contact

Email: contact@elitebotstudios.me

## Technical notes

The website is a static HTML/CSS/vanilla JavaScript project. Lab note sources are in `content/lab-notes/`; project records are in `projects.json`. Calculators provide estimates only and are not design approval or safety certification.
